name: turning_ratios_route_manifest_v2_mfd277_combined_guarded_20260715
description: P-Stack candidate with a VISSIM-facing ramp over-closure guard, no-control fallback, and queue-aware release floor.

calibration_basis.reason: The 155/190/220 congestion ladder showed P-Stack mostly worsened TTT by over-closing ramps while freeway density was not high enough to justify the queue transfer. This guard preserves the calibrated objective but prevents plant-facing ramp actions that release far less than observed no-control capacity under queue/stopped risk.
